description: This Java class 'AutowiredTenantAdapter' extends 'EventBusTenantAdapter' and acts as a Spring component. It uses dependency injection to set a 'TenantService' instance with the qualifier 'backend', providing an implementation of 'getService'. It serves as an adapter to connect tenant management service logic with an event bus-based infrastructure in the Eclipse Hono framework.

classes.name: AutowiredTenantAdapter
classes.description: A Spring component that extends EventBusTenantAdapter, used as a tenant management service adapter within the Hono device registry framework.

methods.name: setService
methods.description: Injects a TenantService instance with qualifier 'backend' into the class.
